description: This file defines a React context for managing a shopping cart in an e-commerce application. It includes context creation, hooks for consuming the context, a reducer for cart state management, and a provider component to supply cart state and actions to child components.

methods.name: useCart
methods.description: Hook to consume the cart context, providing access to cart state and actions.

methods.name: CartProvider
methods.description: Component that provides cart state and actions to its children via React Context.
